name: volt
description: Private read-only access to VOLT training data through the owner's normal site login.

interface.shortDescription: Ask about your VOLT plan and progress.
interface.longDescription: Connect with your existing VOLT login, then let ChatGPT or Codex read your current plan, confirmed workouts, training load, progress, and records. The plugin cannot change data.
defaultPrompt: Что у меня сегодня по плану?
Разбери мой прогресс за последние 12 недель.
